description:
Non-required nits and improvements surfaced by the code review of
explorer-unify-visualization-foundations.  Four Required issues
(vsSlowestRatio inversion for power_score, weak type for
ranking_primary_metric, misleading error message, unthrottled
ResizeObserver) were fixed immediately post-review.  This item tracks
the remaining nit/consider findings.

verifications.description: chartTheme tests pass with extended coverage
Compare tests pass with new cases

verifications.command: cd results-explorer && npm run typecheck && npm test

work_units.notes:
StackedPhase.tsx:27-30 - PHASE_COLORS uses inline hex literals
"#3b82f6", "#10b981", "#f59e0b", "#ef4444" - the same four
palette colors as PALETTE in chartTheme.ts - bypassing paletteColor().

Fix: export PHASE_COLORS from chartTheme.ts or replace inline
literals with paletteColor(0..3).  chartTheme.ts already has the
anti-pattern documented in its docblock.

chartTheme.ts exports HEAT_MIN_RATIO=1 and HEAT_MAX_RATIO=10 but
no file imports them.  chartMath.ts:colorForCell hardcodes the
same values (Math.max(1, Math.min(10, ...))).

Fix: either import HEAT_MIN_RATIO/HEAT_MAX_RATIO in chartMath.ts
and use them in colorForCell, or remove the exports from chartTheme.ts.
The former is cleaner - makes colorForCell respect changes in one place.
work_units.summary: Remove dead HEAT_MIN_RATIO / HEAT_MAX_RATIO exports or use them in colorForCell

work_units.notes:
useElementSize.ts has no standalone test.  It is tested indirectly
through NormalizedSpeedupChart.test.tsx but the fallback path
(typeof ResizeObserver === "undefined"), the cleanup/disconnect call
on unmount, and the hidden-element (0×0) edge case are not exercised.

Add results-explorer/src/__tests__/useElementSize.test.ts covering:
  (a) ResizeObserver unavailable → falls back to offsetWidth
  (b) disconnect() is called on unmount (no leak)
  (c) 0×0 container → stays at defaultWidth (size not updated)
  (d) Same-dimension resize → functional update returns prev (no re-render)

chartTheme.test.ts only tests PALETTE, paletteColor, FASTER_FILL,
SLOWER_FILL, and DIVERGING_MAX_PCT.  These exports are untested:
  - TIME_SERIES_PALETTE / timeSeriesColor
  - HEAT_MIN_RATIO / HEAT_MAX_RATIO
  - SPEEDUP_LOG2_MIN / SPEEDUP_LOG2_MAX / SPEEDUP_LOG2_RANGE
  - SPEEDUP_GRID_STOPS

Add parametrized assertions: correct count, no duplicate values,
expected types, SPEEDUP_LOG2_RANGE == MAX - MIN.
work_units.summary: Extend chartTheme.test.ts to cover untested exports

work_units.notes:
BenchmarkIndex.tsx:325 - `summaryError.startsWith("No benchmark data
available")` is a string-prefix match on a user-visible message.
If manifest.ts changes the message wording, the empty-state branch
silently reverts to the amber error banner.

Fix: export a typed error class or sentinel constant from manifest.ts:
  export class BenchmarkNotPublishedError extends Error { ... }
Then BenchmarkIndex.tsx checks `summaryError instanceof BenchmarkNotPublishedError`.
Or a simpler option: export a sentinel string constant
  export const BENCHMARK_NOT_PUBLISHED = "BENCHMARK_NOT_PUBLISHED";
and throw/check that instead of the user-visible string.
work_units.summary: Replace string-prefix error sentinel in BenchmarkIndex.tsx

work_units.notes:
Compare.test.tsx has a header comment listing 4 test cases but only
implements cases (b) and (c).  Missing:
  (a) Summary card "vs worst"/"vs slowest" value agrees with the
      breakdown table ratio for the same row.
  (d) Baseline selector changes which result is treated as baseline
      in the speedup chart section.

These are regression guards for the dual-speedup fix and the baseline
selection UX.  Add them as additional test functions in Compare.test.tsx.
